dialogue.origin: こんにちは本日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: 13時から始めたいと思います。
dialogue.content: I'd like to start at 1:00 PM.

dialogue.origin: 分かりました。
dialogue.content: Understood.

dialogue.origin: それでは始めます。
dialogue.content: Alright then, let's get started.

dialogue.origin: お願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Please do.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなごそうだんですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 義父が自分の荷物を全て私に持たせる理由が知りたいです。
dialogue.content: I’d like to understand why my father-in-law makes me carry all of his belongings.

dialogue.origin: それは面倒ですよねどのような時にそれを求められますか？
dialogue.content: That sounds burdensome. In what kinds of situations does he ask you to do that?

dialogue.origin: どんな時でもです。どんなに沢山でも重くても全部持たせます。
dialogue.content: All the time. No matter how much there is or how heavy it is, he makes me carry everything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 二人で出かけるときはいつでもということなのですね
dialogue.content: So, it's whenever the two of you go out together?

dialogue.origin: 重い荷物をもたられるのはしんどいですよね
dialogue.content: Being made to carry heavy bags is exhausting, isn’t it?

dialogue.origin: いえ、家族で出かける時はいつもそうです。
dialogue.content: No, it’s always like that when we go out as a family.

dialogue.origin: ご家族と一緒に出かけるときなのですね
dialogue.content: So it's when you go out with your family.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、あなたの年齢と性別をおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.content: By the way, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 50代、女性です。
dialogue.content: I’m a woman in my 50s.

dialogue.origin: おしえていただき、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 一緒に出かけるご家族は、他にはどんな方がいますか？
dialogue.content: Who else in your family goes out with you?

dialogue.origin: 夫、義母、たまに義妹です。
dialogue.content: My husband, my mother-in-law, and sometimes my sister-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんがいるのに何も持ってくれないのですか？
dialogue.content: Even though your husband is there, he doesn’t carry anything?

dialogue.origin: それでは,なんで私ばかりが持たなくてはって思いますよね
dialogue.content: That must make you think, 'Why am I the only one who has to carry everything?'

dialogue.origin: 主人は持病があるため、頼むことが出来ず、いつも私が全部の荷物を運びます
dialogue.content: My husband has a chronic illness, so I can't ask him for help. I always end up carrying all the bags.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですか
dialogue.content: Oh, I see. That's why.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 義父さんのお体はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.content: How is your father-in-law’s health?

dialogue.origin: 年老いて荷物を持てそうにないとか
dialogue.content: Is he elderly and unable to carry things,

dialogue.origin: それほどでもないとか
dialogue.content: or is it not that severe?

dialogue.origin: まだ足腰は悪くなく、元気に歩けます。実は結婚当初から、義父はペットボトル一つ自分で持たずに無言で私に渡します
dialogue.content: His legs and back are still fine, and he can walk briskly. In fact, ever since we got married, he doesn’t even carry a single plastic bottle himself—he silently hands it to me.

dialogue.origin: それでは自分で持って欲しいと思いますよね
dialogue.content: That would make you wish he would carry it himself, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたが不満に感じても当然だと思います
dialogue.content: I think it's perfectly natural for you to feel dissatisfied.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: ただ、嫌な訳ではないのです。今現在持つ体力はありますし。
dialogue.content: But it's not that I hate it. I have the physical strength to carry things right now.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねでも、やっぱりモヤモヤしますよね
dialogue.content: I see. But it still leaves you feeling uneasy, doesn’t it?

dialogue.origin: 義父の心理が分かって、その理由が府に落ちたら、荷物運びも、今よりもっと気持ちよくできるような気がするのですが
dialogue.content: If I could understand my father-in-law’s mindset and the reason made sense to me, I feel I could carry the bags more willingly than I do now.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね理由がわからないと、何で？って思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Right. When you don’t know the reason, it’s natural to wonder, 'Why?'

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたはそのお気持ちを夫さんにお話してみたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever tried talking to your husband about how you feel?

dialogue.origin: 結婚当初から義父の荷物を持ってきたので、まだ話してはいません
dialogue.content: I’ve been carrying my father-in-law’s things since we first got married, so I haven’t talked to him about it yet.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか夫さんなら、義父さんのことが良くお分かりかもと思ったのですが、
dialogue.content: I see. I thought your husband might understand your father-in-law well, but...

dialogue.origin: あなたはどう思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 折を見て、一度聞いてみようかと思いました
dialogue.content: I was thinking I might try asking him once when the time is right.

dialogue.origin: そうですねそれも一つの方法かもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Yes, that could be one way to approach it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 義父さんに直接聞ければ早いのですが、
dialogue.content: It would be quickest if you could ask your father-in-law directly, but...

dialogue.origin: それってハードルが高そうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: does that seem like too high of a hurdle?

dialogue.origin: 長い間そうしてきたので、聞きづらいです
dialogue.content: It’s hard to ask because we’ve been doing it this way for so long.

dialogue.origin: 確かにそうですよね
dialogue.content: I can certainly see that.

dialogue.origin: 言い方が難しそうですものね
dialogue.content: It does seem hard to find the right words.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり夫さんに聞くのが一番いいのかもですね
dialogue.content: Perhaps asking your husband is the best option after all.

dialogue.origin: 実は夫にも少々聞きづらいです。これまで私のすることをずっと見てきたのに、何も言ってくれなかったですから
dialogue.content: To be honest, it’s a little hard to ask my husband too. He’s watched me do this all this time and has never said anything.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたとしては、話さなくても解って欲しかったのですよね
dialogue.content: You wanted him to understand even without you having to say it, didn’t you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。目の前で見ているのですから
dialogue.content: That’s right—he sees it happening right in front of him.

dialogue.origin: その辺りは微妙なところですよね
dialogue.content: That can be a tricky area, can't it?

dialogue.origin: 結局、二人とも同じ考えなのではと思ってしまいます
dialogue.content: In the end, I can't help but think they both have the same idea.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは義父さんと自分のどちらを大事に思ってくれているのかって、気になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: It makes you wonder whether your husband values your father-in-law more, or you, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: それって、よくありがちな夫婦のすれ違いのテーマなんですよね
dialogue.content: That’s actually a common theme in marital misunderstandings.

dialogue.origin: うーん
dialogue.content: Hmm.

dialogue.origin: 多くの場合は義母とな関係なんですが
dialogue.content: In many cases, it's the relationship with the mother-in-law, but...

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさいねありがちなんて書いてしまって
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for saying it's 'common'.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: 多くの夫婦がそこですれ違う注意箇所みたいなところがあるので
dialogue.content: It's because it's a common pitfall where many couples have misunderstandings.

dialogue.origin: 妻としては夫さんに自分の方を大事にしてほしいですよね
dialogue.content: As a wife, you want your husband to prioritize you, don't you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: でも夫さんとしては、身内の方を大事に思っていたりする
dialogue.content: But from the husband’s perspective, he may prioritize his family of origin.

dialogue.origin: どうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: 人にもよるとは思いますが
dialogue.content: I suppose it depends on the person.

dialogue.origin: 血のつながりというのが案外強いのかなと思ったりしますでも、そこで夫婦として大事なのは、相手の気持ちを理解することなのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I feel that blood ties can be surprisingly strong. But in that situation, what's important as a married couple is to understand each other's feelings, don't you think?

dialogue.origin: おっしゃる通りですね。でも、私は辛いのです
dialogue.content: You're right. But it's painful for me.

dialogue.origin: なので、あなたの気持ち、つまり自分の方を大事にしてほしいという気持ち、を夫さんにも解っておいてもらう必要があるのかと思うのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.content: So, I think it might be necessary for your husband to understand your feelings—that is, the feeling that you want him to prioritize you. What do you think of that?

dialogue.origin: はい、おっしゃる通りです
dialogue.content: Yes, you're absolutely right.

dialogue.origin: 言われてみないと気がつかないということもあるので、あなたのお気持ちを夫さんに伝えてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Sometimes people don't realize things until they're told, so how about trying to convey your feelings to your husband?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。夫の身内4人を相手にする覚悟で話さないといけないので、とても勇気が要りますが、それしか無いですかね。怖い気がしますけど
dialogue.content: You're right. I'll have to speak to him with the resolve of facing all four of his family members, so it will take a lot of courage, but I guess that's the only way. It feels scary, though.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、勇気を持ってお話してみてください
dialogue.content: Yes, please gather your courage and try talking to him.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I will.

dialogue.origin: 最後の方は時間がなくて性急になってしまい済みませんでしが、時間が少し過ぎてしまいましたので、これで終わらせていただきます
dialogue.content: I apologize for rushing at the end as we were running out of time, but since we've gone a little over, we'll have to end here.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうぞ
dialogue.content: Yes, of course.

dialogue.origin: 本日はお忙しい所を大変ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you so much for your time today, I know you're busy.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

topic.sub: 義父とのコミュニケーション問題
